scenes.say: Pain is information, not a life sentence.
scenes.visual: a man sitting on the edge of a bed in a dim room, elbows on knees

scenes.say: It is showing you what has to change.
scenes.visual: a cracked sidewalk with a small green plant growing through it

scenes.say: You can sit in it, or you can use it.
scenes.visual: a heavy punching bag hanging in an empty gym, light from a high window
a man hitting a punching bag hard, sweat and motion
close up of a hand writing fast in a worn notebook

scenes.say: Let it push you forward instead of down.
scenes.visual: a runner on a bridge at sunrise, city behind, seen from the side

scenes.say: Follow for more. Turn negative into positive.
scenes.visual: a bright sunrise over a river and city skyline
